newsitem.title: DUBAI: Two senior Saudi ministers to visit S. Africa.
newsitem.headline: Two senior Saudi ministers to visit S. Africa.

text.p: South African Deputy President Thabo Mbeki, on an official visit to Saudi Arabia, said on Sunday that two senior Saudi ministers would travel to South Africa next year to discuss bilateral cooperation.

Mbeki told reporters in the capital Riyadh that the Saudi Minister of Defence and Aviation Prince Sultan and the Minister of Foreign Affairs Prince Saud al-Faisal would make separate visits to South Africa.
He said the two countries would also sign an agreement on bilateral cooperation in 1997.

Mbeki, who arrived in the kingdom on Friday, has held talks with top officials from the ministries of industry and electricity, foreign affairs and oil to discuss cooperation between the two countries.
